reports.notes: Handwritten block capitals. *** OFFICE SEEKING IS BLANK ON THE PAGE *** - the Office Seeking cell (and the phone/fax cells) are completely empty, so office_printed is '' . This DISAGREES with office_index, which carries 'County Commission Seat C'; nothing on either page of this filing states an office, so no office is transcribed. AMENDMENT: neither the 'Yes' nor the 'No' box is checked, so is_amendment is ''. Cents on lines 1 Column A and 2 (both columns) and line 7 are written as RAISED superscripts over the decimal point ('13,212' + raised '30'; '5,684.' + raised '06'; '7528.' + raised '24'); they are transcribed as full decimals. These readings were confirmed by enlarging the cells: line 4's thousands digit, which at page scale can look like an 8, is the filer's flat-topped 2 (13,212.30, matching lines 1 and 5). Line 3 is a hand-drawn oval zero. Line 7 alone is written WITHOUT a thousands comma ('7528.24'); kept as printed. contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (13,212.30, the dollars written on the rule with the cents '30' RAISED above it) on the p2 Summary Page, which is ALSO Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 13,212.30' and its printed 'Total Contributions Received $ 13,212.30', and is repeated in full at summary line 4
contributions.detail: 11 Schedule A rows sum to 4836.30 + 500.00 + 25.00 + 100.00 + 1.00 + 50.00 + 50.00 + 600.00 + 5000.00 + 2000.00 + 50.00 = 13,212.30 exactly = the schedule's own printed page subtotal = the schedule's printed total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD cell (Column A). THE LOAN QUESTION WAS DECIDED BY THE ARITHMETIC and it came out the OPPOSITE way from Witney 2010 (ADDENDUM A4): row 1 is the candidate's own 4,836.30 'LOAN TO SELF' written onto the contributions ledger, and here it IS an itemized contribution - without it the rows sum to 8,376.00 against a printed 13,212.30, and the summary's line 3 Balance at Beginning is an oval ZERO, so there is no beginning-balance slot for the loan to have gone into. Column B Year-to-Date also prints 13,212.30, the normal first-report-of-cycle case, so this is `exact` and not `cumulative-exact`. The ladder is internally exact: line 3 = 0, + line 4 13,212.30 = line 5 subtotal 13,212.30, - line 6 5,684.06 = line 7 close 7,528.24, all as printed.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (5,684.06, cents raised) on the p2 Summary Page, which is ALSO Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 5684.06' and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received $ 5684.06', and is repeated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 11 Schedule B rows sum to 519.48 + 21.78 + 42.47 + 28.59 + 29.69 + 994.29 + 391.07 + 1371.72 + 885.44 + 600.00 + 799.53 = 5,684.06 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Column A. No amount needed escalating; both sides closed on the first full-page read. Column B Year-to-Date prints 5,684.06 (first report of the cycle) and is never summed as an increment. CORROBORATION WORTH NOTING: row 1 pays the Utah County Clerk 519.48, the same figure to the cent that Larry Alton Ellertson pays the Utah County Clerk on his own 2012 pre-primary filing (key e00a4fae) - the 2012 county candidate filing fee. Two independent filings agreeing on a third-party figure is a useful check on both transcriptions; it was not used to derive anything.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed exactly on BOTH sides (13,212.30 and 5,684.06). This form prints no in-kind column and no row on either schedule is marked in-kind, so the monetary-plus-in-kind convention gives the identical sums and also closes. Both conventions tested per the per-filer rule.
itemized.escalation_note: Ten crops. Four are the geometry proofs. Six resolved LEGIBILITY of names and dates, none of amounts (no amount was in doubt - both sides closed to the cent on the 200 dpi read): the p3 row-1 name at 1600 dpi (the candidate's own 'LOAN TO SELF' line), the p3 row-2 and row-7 names at 1600 dpi, the p3 row-9 date at 1600 dpi (an overwritten leading digit), and the p4 row-2 and row-9 rows at 1400 dpi. Two 700 dpi full-width strips over p3 bands 1-5 and 6-11 served as the field-shift screen.

itemized.notes: Page-face candidate 'LORNE W GRIERSON' (verification block 'LORNE GRIERSON'), Political Party REPUBLICAN, residence city Orem UT. index.csv names NO candidate for this row (channel label 'Grierson - 06/19/12'), so the page face supplies the name. ⚠ THE OFFICE SEEKING CELL IS BLANK ON THE PAGE, and so are the phone and fax cells - the filer left the whole bottom band of the cover's identity block empty. index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat C' from the acquisition channel (the 2008-2018 listing groups by office and encodes it in the PDF path), and NOTHING ON THIS DOCUMENT CORROBORATES OR CONTRADICTS THAT. Recorded here so the channel's office is visibly uncorroborated for this filing; no office is inferred, and this record does not adjudicate it. AMENDMENT: NEITHER the Yes box NOR the No box is ticked - an honest BLANK, never 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). Report type 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' ticked. DATE DISAGREEMENT INSIDE THE FILING, not adjudicated: the cover signature is dated 6-18-2012 while all three following sheets print 'Date of Report 6-19-12'; the clerk stamp reads JUN 19 AM 11:22 and the county's filename says 061912. All transcribed as printed. Foliation 2/3/4 'of 4', INCLUDING the cover, like Ellertson and unlike Ballard. 4 pages on the 2012 legacy_colAB blank characterised on key 9630b1c7, each classified from its own printed header; the summary page (p2) was located by its printed heading. RAISED CENTS ARE THIS FILER'S HOUSE STYLE: most amounts on the summary page and on Schedule A print the dollars on the rule with the cents as a small superscript ('13,212' + raised '30', '5,684' + raised '06', '500' + raised '00'); each is that many cents, per the frozen contract. BOTH SIDES CLOSE EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A figure and on each schedule's own printed subtotal and total. ⚠ A PRIVACY / COVERAGE PROPERTY WORTH REPORTING: NOT ONE ROW OF THIS SCHEDULE A NAMES A CITY. The filer wrote street line + ZIP CODE only on all eleven donor rows, so the privacy reduction to city/state yields NOTHING and donor_city/donor_state are honestly blank on every contribution row - blank because the form carries no city, not because the county redacted it (this is not a *_Redacted.pdf; ADDENDUM A5) and not because the filer left the cell empty. The zip codes were NOT converted into city names: that would be inference, not transcription. Analysts should expect legible, complete donor addresses in this era to still produce empty city/state columns.
